source_findings: current deployment library synthesizes contract id and transaction hash locally rather than establishing authoritative chain deployment evidence
deployment UI simulates a confirmation delay and can display Network confirmed for that local receipt
WASMProcessor falls back from SHA-256 to a non-cryptographic 32-bit FNV-like hash
generic app storage silently falls back from IndexedDB to localStorage, which is unsuitable for atomic registry semantics
BroadcastChannel exists and is reusable as an invalidation transport but registry writes need persisted revision conflict detection
Stellar network config already exposes passphrase and Soroban RPC seams
contractStorage already provides direct contract-instance reads useful for instance drift
compatibility subsystem already demonstrates schema versioning, redaction, import validation, bounded timeouts, overrides and degraded states
global audit trail is bounded/clearable and should not be the sole durable registry history
devops canary/Kubernetes risk scoring is not an authoritative Soroban promotion gate

architecture.database: dedicated stellar-deployment-registry IndexedDB; no localStorage mutation fallback
architecture.concurrency: per-entity revision plus monotonic registryRevision; BroadcastChannel invalidation after commit
architecture.drift: on-chain executable WASM hash plus canonical instance-state hash with freshness and partial-scope labels
architecture.promotion: deterministic fail-closed state machine; unknown/unavailable blocks
architecture.audit: transactional registry events; optional local hash chain is tamper-evident, not externally immutable
architecture.external_reconciliation: preserve unknown historical fields; never fabricate deployer/constructor/creation tx
architecture.ui: new lazy deploymentRegistry tab with registry, environment diff, promotion, provenance, timeline, import/export
